# IBM Services Essentials

The IBM Services Essentials category has 3 tasks. Each entry shows the task's latest revision, the one the palette adds. See [Reading an entry](./overview#reading-an-entry).

> [!WARNING]
> These tasks call IBM Services Essentials services. They work only on a Flow installation that runs inside IBM Services Essentials.

## Create Support Center Ticket

Creates a support center ticket. Should be used when you got a problem, found a bug or just need some help

- **Slug:** `create-support-center-ticket`
- **Type:** `template`
- **Revision:** 1
- **Image:** Default task image.

> [!NOTE]
> Works only on a Flow installation that runs inside IBM Services Essentials.

**Parameters**

| Label | Name | Type | Required | Default | Helper text |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Support Center URL | `url` | URL | Yes |  |  |
| Access Token | `accessToken` | Secured | Yes |  |  |
| Ticket Owner Id | `ownerId` | Text | Yes |  | The owner id of the ticket |
| Team Id | `teamId` | Text | No |  | Set the team id the ticket is related to |
| Catalog item | `catalogServiceId` | Text | No |  |  |
| Subject | `subject` | Text | Yes |  | What's this ticket about? |
| Description | `description` | Text Area | Yes |  | Give us all the details |
| Ticket Type | `type` | Select | Yes |  |  |

No results.
